Priya Raman: quick handoff to @Daniel — i'm heading offline in 30m. summary: INC-573 (Search API intermittent 502s) — symptoms started 2026-11-27 19:04 UTC, customer-visible for Shoply and internal search-svc. status: service degraded but route-level failover is working; active mitigation in place.
Daniel Liu: taking primary. what's the most recent mitigation? any workarounds for customers?
Priya Raman: rolled back a recent routing rule for long queries (`search-long-q-v2`) and applied temporary request-size cap (payload <= 64KB) at the edge for Shoply. that dropped 502s from ~4% to ~0.7% but p95 latency still elevated ~900ms.
Noor Patel: what's the PD escalation path? Is Pager on for kernel folks?
Priya Raman: Pager policy: Search API P1 pages to primary (you), then secondary (Noor), then Kernel oncall (Javier) after 10m if unresolved. Pager name: Search-API - Errors. Mute earlier noisy alert `search_cache_warmup` — i've muted it for 45m.
Daniel Liu: noted. which alerts should i watch in the next hour?
Priya Raman: monitor `search_502_rate > 1%`, `search_p95 > 1200ms`, and `search_queue_depth > 30`. also keep an eye on `edge_payload_rejects` (we're rejecting over-size now). runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/search-api (see "immediate rollback" and "edge caps").
Javier Gomez: if you need a kernel-level dump, the usual command is below (ops-shell required):
```
# capture core + kv metrics
./ops/dump_search_core.sh --cluster=search-prod --node $NODE_ID --out /tmp/dump.tar.gz
gsutil cp /tmp/dump.tar.gz gs://redwood-ops-dumps/search/${INC_ID}/
```
Javier Gomez: also check `worker_kv_evictions` and `async_flush_lat_ms` in CloudMetrics.
Noor Patel: i'll be secondary for the next 8h. if you ACK a P1 and need me to take over, ping me loud.
Daniel Liu: any deploy blockers? i won't touch infra changes.
Priya Raman: don't merge the `search-optimizer` rollout; it's paused. safe to adjust edge caps and toggle route weights. avoid restarting entire node pool unless runbook instructs.
OpsBot: Incident INC-573 created: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-573 — Sev: P2 -> P1 if errors > 3% for 5m.
Daniel Liu: thanks. can someone paste the quick restart snippet? prefer not to use it unless necessary but have it ready.
Noor Patel: adding restart (use only per-runbook):
```
# ops-shell
./ops/restart_search_worker.sh --cluster=search-prod --region=us-east1 --grace=90
```
Noor Patel: logs bucket: gs://redwood-logs/search/prod/2026-11-27/ — tail the latest two. grep for `request_id=` and `kv_cache:error` to find correlated traces.
Daniel Liu: creating follow-ups now. i'll open tickets for diagnostic work and postmortem.
Daniel Liu: TICKET: RDW-7901 "INC-573: KV eviction diagnostic" assigned to @Javier due 2026-12-03
Daniel Liu: TICKET: RDW-7902 "Postmortem INC-573" assigned to @Priya due 2026-11-30
Daniel Liu: scheduling retro: Tue 2026-11-30 09:00 PST (30m) — invite to responders + product. RetrosBot, please send invite.
RetrosBot: Retro scheduled Tue 2026-11-30 09:00 PST — Notes doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/retros/INC-573. Invite sent to Priya, Daniel, Noor, Javier, product-search.
Javier Gomez: quick observation: worker heap trend shows growth tied to long-query parsing. hypothesis: parser buffer not bounded for >2k tokens. will prototype a fix and bench it.
Priya Raman: action items captured:
- Priya: finalize rollback notes and update runbook (add edge cap rollout section) — RDW-7903 — due 2026-11-29
- Daniel: open diagnostic tickets + postmortem and coordinate retro — RDW-7901/7902 — due 2026-11-28
- Javier: run KV eviction diagnostic, attach dumps to RDW-7901, prototype parser buffer cap — due 2026-12-05
- Noor: verify PD routing for APAC and confirm secondary coverage — due 2026-11-28
Noor Patel: coverage note: potential overnight APAC gap 00:00-06:00 UTC on Mon-Tue. can we route APAC pages to global-eng-infra or have a volunteer? @Daniel can you cover 02:00-06:00 UTC Monday?
Daniel Liu: i can cover Monday 02:00-05:00 UTC (partial). if full coverage required, route to eng-infra global. i'll add that to the oncall-schedule doc.
Priya Raman: thanks — i'll update the schedule and add explicit APAC routing rule before i sign off.
Noor Patel: one more: when paging, include `example_id` and `request_id` in the first message — that speeds triage.
Daniel Liu: ack — will do. first check in 20m, then hourly if stable. i'll post any changes here and update the incident ticket.
OpsBot: Reminder: Pager routing updated — Search-API primary: Daniel Liu, secondary: Noor Patel for next 12h. If no ack in 10m escalate to Javier Gomez.
Priya Raman: leaving my mobile off but reachable via email if urgent. good luck and thanks all.
Daniel Liu: taking over now. posting status checkpoints to #incidents. starting with a quick metrics snapshot in 10m.
Javier Gomez: i'll start the dump and a lightweight heap profile during my overlap window and push results to RDW-7901.
Daniel Liu: closing handoff — first scheduled check at 20:10 UTC. if nothing new, downgrade updates to hourly. :white_check_mark:
